notes: history_pass scored 4 for two defects in the canonical's history section, both in the derivation rather than the outcome. Cause (a): the section contradicts its own stated rule — it opens with 'The pass is owed off the exposure, not the arm' and then derives the obligation as 'a repo with no remote on record owes what its arm owes — on the any row, a pass', which is arm-based reasoning of exactly the kind the sentence before it disclaims. It lands on the right disjunct (a full public arm IS one of the two exposures §8 names) and it correctly refuses the vacuous named-skip a zero-remote repo would otherwise license — 'every remote on record reads private' is trivially true over an empty remote set — but the refusal is carried in T0 rather than derived here. Cause (b): §8 says the uncovered refs are named as §9's own not-shipped dimension and 'never a scope note inside a passing check'; the report elevates the dimension correctly to the top-level scope line, then restates it inside the passing check as a paragraph that asserts it is not a caveat hiding inside a passing check. Nothing is concealed, but the paragraph is the shape the clause forbids. The rest of the check is right: the row carries a commit so it is not treated as absent, full-clone corpus is established via rev-parse --is-shallow-repository before the row is read as recordable, currency is compared as merge-base --is-ancestor main 5e4d3c2 in the correct direction (audited ref reachable from recorded commit), the result is reported current for the audited ref and explicitly not for the repo, no new row is written, and the AI workspace is named-skipped with its observed PRIVATE value rather than scored as a missed degradation. Everything else is at 5. observed_gate: keys on the enumeration plus gh read, classifies zero remotes as 'no remote on record' rather than as an indeterminate read, raises no remote finding, treats the unset manifest visibility field as a note, and engages the posture-as-intent-axis rule explicitly before correctly declining to fire it (open-core posture, repo not observed-public). repo_set: set built from the manifest's repository objects with the absence of others stated; canonical routed to the any row's full arms fail-closed, ai_workspace to the private moat-holder secrets-scan-only row; no check removed anywhere. no_silent_narrowing: every input present and no degradation manufactured, with each non-degradation named against the class it would have fallen into (rules block parses, gitleaks completed over a non-empty root, enumeration untruncated, sweep not narrowed). semantic_pass: inventory located first, open-core over a non-empty inventory runs the pass in full, S3 clean with no S1/S2 invented, and the ai_workspace skip named. scan_first: ls-files --others deliberately without --exclude-standard runs first and classification second, .env.local restated as a standing warning without escalating and NOTES-STRATEGY.md raised as a new finding, with the judgment read explicitly covering what the pattern pass missed. disposition: the finding reaches the operator, the risk argument is correctly held to be not a rejection, neither unblock applies, CONFIRMED blocks, no override manufactured, and the allowlist-edit path is named as an accepted disclosure rather than a cheaper fix. verdict_shape: one verdict, BLOCKED, naming the confirmed finding, one block per repo each opening with a six-check coverage line of ran / skipped-with-observed-value, no INCONCLUSIVE invented, scope named by class up front. tree_pinning: ref resolved from the spines' base_branch with default_branch as cross-check, HEAD proven to be that ref by comparing resolved object ids, both quiet diffs qualified as evidence by ls-files -v carrying no h or S, no halt manufactured, and the secrets-scan-only arm correctly reported ran-clean off the two diff checks rather than penalised for not scanning. submodule_descent: no descent manufactured, no seventh coverage entry added, and the negative stated as scope rather than as a result.
